independence: The independent original-Core models and existing proof cross-checks were completed first. Producer static source preparation, explicitly allowed by Root, preceded whole binary freezing; no new producer/reader SUT, compilation or CLI had executed at freeze. This oracle author did not read new producer/reader implementations or outputs. No subprocess, Source, VM, eval, Host or Tool9 invocation by the oracle author.

dtoConventions.header: Descriptor names version/schema, not wireVersion/schemaHash; all Hash fields use sha256: plus 64 lowercase hex digits.
dtoConventions.ranges: Two-element [start,end] arrays of exact UTF16 offsets.
dtoConventions.typesAndKinds: Numeric descriptor Type, opcode and ScalarUse.kind tags.
dtoConventions.constant: metadata.value is exact 16 lowercase f64 bits as a string, or a full-u32 number; never host f64 conversion.
dtoConventions.nonReferenceBinding: Explicit empty string in DTO; zero wire bytes; never a zero hash.
dtoConventions.optionalLocalAnnotations: annotations object always contains annotationRange and elementAnnotationRange; both [] or both a Range. Wire tag derived uniquely.
dtoConventions.tails: TypeOrigin Array/View tails are direct elementType/indexSignatureRange fields, with readonly:1 only View. Array Parameter alone has elementAnnotationRange.
dtoConventions.booleans: writable/readonly are numeric1, matching exact u8 wire values.
dtoConventions.counts: Every sequence count is derived from its complete DTO array. Offsets include actual encoded count and UTF8 byteLength fields; no duplicate independent DTO count authority.
dtoConventions.originalCore: Source fixture/Core pins and marker migration are outside decoded; they are not production Source authenticity authority.

wireStructuralMinimums.meaning: Proven structural wire lower bounds, before nested allocation; not a claim to the smallest semantically valid complete module.
wireStructuralMinimums.FunctionBoundProof: 166 fixed prefix + at least3 instructions * shortest possible encoded instruction15. This is a safe structural lower bound, not an asserted semantic minimum.
